easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Yannik until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
